overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（3 篇）、公司金融（2 篇）、资产定价（2 篇）。方法上以调查数据、机器学习为主。来源分布：Semantic Scholar（7 篇）、OpenAlex（5 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Inductive Biases in Field-level Cosmological Inference from Galaxy Catalogs
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    We perform field-level likelihood-free inference of the matter density parameter Ω
                    
                      m
                    
                    from simulated galaxy catalogs using machine learning models with differing inductive biases. Using hydrodynamic simulations from CAMELS, we examine how observable choice and architecture govern cosmological information extraction. We consider galaxy positions and line-of-sight peculiar velocities, separately and jointly, and compare permutation-invariant deep sets, implemented with either multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) or Kolmogorov–Arnold networks (KANs), to graph neural networks (GNNs), which explicitly encode spatial relations. We test in-distribution and out-of-distribution (OOD) performance across simulations with different subgrid galaxy-formation prescriptions. Deep sets infer Ω
                    
                      m
                    
                    from velocities alone with mean relative errors of approximately 18% in-distribution and ∼25% OOD, with KANs and MLPs achieving comparable performance. In contrast, the same set-based approach does not yield useful
                    σ
                    8
                    predictions in either in-distribution or cross-suite tests. Adding positions does not improve deep sets, while GNNs infer Ω
                    
                      m
                    
                    with mean relative errors of about 10% in-distribution and 10%–17% OOD. These results indicate that peculiar velocities provide the dominant source of Ω
                    
                      m
                    
                    information for set-based models in this setting, while spatial information is most effectively used by architectures that explicitly encode galaxy–galaxy relations. Because the velocity inputs are exact simulated peculiar velocities, applications to survey data will require validation under realistic velocity-measurement noise, selection effects, and survey geometry.

papers.title: AI-Enabled Wearable Sensor Technologies for Athlete Performance Monitoring: A Critical Review of Signal Processing, Machine Learning, and Real-Time Embedded Systems
papers.abstract:
Abstract
Wearable sensing and artificial intelligence (AI) are increasingly being used to quantify athlete movement, physiological response, training load, and recovery in field and laboratory settings. However, the practical value of these systems depends not only on the predictive capability of an algorithm but also on sensor validity, signal quality, hardware constraints, real-time processing, and the transferability of models across athletes and sports. This review examines the technical pipeline linking wearable electronic sensors to athlete-monitoring decisions, with particular attention to inertial measurement units, global navigation satellite systems, photoplethysmography, electrocardiography, electromyography, pressure sensing, and multimodal systems. It synthesizes evidence on signal conditioning, segmentation, feature engineering, classical machine learning, deep learning, sensor fusion, edge inference, and embedded implementation. Existing reviews indicate that wearable devices can support useful monitoring, but accuracy varies by metric, device, movement pattern, and validation setting; performance under controlled conditions should not be assumed to generalize to competition. Key challenges include motion artifacts, inconsistent protocols, small and imbalanced datasets, leakage between training and test sets, limited external validation, battery and communication constraints, privacy, and unclear decision thresholds. The review proposes a layered reference architecture and a validation framework that links engineering performance to sport-specific usefulness. Future research should prioritize synchronized multimodal datasets, athlete-independent testing, interpretable and uncertainty-aware models, energy-efficient edge AI, secure data governance, and transparent reporting. The article’s contribution is an engineering-oriented synthesis that connects sensor physics and embedded constraints with the needs of physical education and sports science.

papers.title: The interplay between renewable energy, green finance, and economic development: A bibliometric review
papers.abstract: Type of the article: Research ArticleAbstractResearch on the relationships among green finance, renewable energy, and economic development has expanded rapidly in recent years; however, the intellectual structure, collaboration patterns, and thematic evolution of this interdisciplinary field remain insufficiently understood. This study addresses this gap by conducting a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of publications indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection using VOSviewer and Biblioshiny, the web interface of the bibliometrix R package. The analytical framework integrates performance analysis with science mapping techniques, including keyword co-occurrence, citation, co-citation, bibliographic coupling, thematic mapping, and thematic evolution analyses. The findings reveal substantial growth in scientific production and increasing international collaboration, while identifying an intellectual foundation primarily shaped by studies on econometric methodologies, the relationships between economic growth and environmental sustainability, and the integration of green finance with energy economics. Four major research streams emerge: green financial instruments and markets; the finance, growth, and emissions nexus; renewable energy transition and policy; and advanced quantitative modeling approaches. Thematic evolution further indicates that, although green finance, renewable energy, and sustainable development remain the core research themes, emerging topics such as digital finance and the digital economy are receiving increasing scholarly attention. By providing a comprehensive knowledge map of the field, this study contributes to a better understanding of its intellectual foundations, conceptual development, and future research directions, while offering valuable insights for researchers and policymakers seeking to promote sustainable finance, renewable energy transition, and long-term economic development.
papers.summary_zh:
【绿色金融与可持续发展】文章类型：研究论文  
摘要：  
近年来，关于绿色金融、可再生能源与经济发展之间关系的研究迅速发展，但这一跨学科领域的知识结构、合作模式及主题演变仍缺乏深入理解。本研究通过使用VOSviewer和Biblioshiny（bibliometrix R包的网页界面）对Web of Science Core Collection中的相关文献进行全面的文献计量分析，填补了这一研究空白。分析框架结合了绩效评估与科学可视化技术，包括关键词共现、引用关系、文献耦合、主题映射及主题演变分析等方法。研究结果表明，该领域的学术产出显著增长，国际合作日益加强；同时发现其知识基础主要体现在计量经济学方法研究、经济增长与环境可持续性的关系，以及绿色金融与能源经济学的融合方面。研究梳理出四个主要的研究方向：绿色金融工具与市场、金融、增长与排放之间的关联、可再生能源转型与政策，以及先进的定量建模方法。主题演变分析进一步表明，尽管绿色金融、可再生能源与可持续发展仍是核心研究主题，但数字金融和数字经济等新兴议题也日益受到学术界的关注。通过构建该领域的全面知识图谱，本研究有助于更深入地理解其知识基础、概念发展及未...。

papers.title: Financing viable distressed firms in Morocco: designing a public risk-sharing mechanism for bank restructuring finance
papers.venue: International Journal of Research in Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: When banks are least inclined to extend risk due to financial hardship, viable businesses may need more liquidity. In order to assist real bank new money during corporate restructuring, this essay presents a legislative design for a specific Moroccan public risk-sharing system. The study makes use of secondary Moroccan information, legal-institutional analysis, qualitative documentary analysis, and comparative benchmarking of governmental credit-guarantee programs. It concludes that although Morocco already has the key components—Book V protections for specific new financing, TAMWILCOM's guaranty infrastructure, a track record of restructuring cofinancing, and recent prudential reforms—these components do not constitute a specific framework for restructuring new money. Targeting companies whose distress is significant but whose underlying business model is still viable, the proposed Moroccan Restructuring Finance Guaranty Window would primarily rely on partial pari passu loss sharing; require newness, necessity, proportionality, additionality, and traceability; maintain significant lender exposure; and condition guaranty calls on monitoring and use-of-proceeds compliance. The contribution is an integrated approach that minimizes fiscal risk and moral hazard while connecting insolvency legislation, credit-guarantee design, prudential controls, and ex post impact evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】当银行因财务困境而最不愿意承担风险时，具有生存能力的企业可能更需要流动性。为了在企业重组期间为银行提供资金支持，本文提出了一种针对摩洛哥公共风险分担机制的立法设计方案。研究采用了摩洛哥的二手数据、法律制度分析、定性文献分析以及对政府信贷担保计划的比较研究方法。研究结果表明，尽管摩洛哥已经具备相关关键要素——如《第五册》法规中对新型融资的支持、TAMWILCOM的担保体系、在重组项目中的共同融资经验以及近期的审慎监管改革——但这些要素尚未形成一个完整的重组融资框架。该提案提出的“摩洛哥重组融资担保机制”主要针对那些陷入困境但商业模式仍具有可行性的企业，其核心原则包括：部分损失共担机制；强调融资的新颖性、必要性、适度性及附加性；确保贷款人的风险敞口处于可控范围；并将担保的触发条件与企业的监控情况及资金使用情况挂钩。这一综合性的解决方案旨在降低财政风险和道德风险，同时将破产法规、信贷担保设计、审慎监管措施以及事后影响评估有机结合在一起。。

papers.title: Validity of the Assignment of Receivables and Allocation of Default Risk in Factoring Agreements in Indonesia
papers.abstract: Anjak piutang merupakan kegiatan pembiayaan melalui pembelian piutang usaha yang menimbulkan peralihan hak tagih dan persoalan pembagian risiko wanprestasi debitur. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis keabsahan peralihan piutang serta pembagian risiko wanprestasi dalam skema with recourse dan without recourse berdasarkan asas keseimbangan. Penelitian hukum normatif menggunakan pendekatan perundang-undangan dan konseptual dengan interpretasi gramatikal serta sistematis terhadap ketentuan hukum perdata, peraturan perusahaan pembiayaan, dan literatur ilmiah. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa keabsahan perjanjian pembelian, penyerahan piutang melalui cessie, dan keberlakuan pengalihan terhadap debitur mempunyai persyaratan serta akibat hukum berbeda. Tanggung jawab penjual atas keberadaan piutang dibedakan dari penanggungan kemampuan debitur memenuhi kewajibannya. Dalam with recourse, pembagian risiko ditentukan berdasarkan substansi klausul, batas penanggungan, dan akibat pembayaran terhadap hak tagih. Dalam without recourse, risiko tidak tertagihnya piutang yang sah ditanggung perusahaan pembiayaan, sedangkan kewajiban debitur dan tanggung jawab penjual atas keberadaan piutang tetap berlaku. Penanggungan pihak ketiga, pembelian kembali piutang, dan subrogasi menimbulkan akibat hukum sesuai dasar perikatannya. Asas keseimbangan digunakan untuk menentukan kesesuaian manfaat, kewajiban, pembebanan risiko, dan batas tuntutan. Kepastian hukum bagi para pihak memerlukan kejelasan objek, pemenuhan persyaratan pengalihan, serta pengaturan akibat pembayaran yang mencegah pemenuhan tuntutan melebihi hak yang sah.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】“Anjak piutang”（债权购买）是一种通过收购企业债务来提供融资的活动，该行为会导致债权所有权的转移以及债务人违约风险的分担问题。本研究旨在基于“平衡原则”（principle of balance），分析在有追索权（with recourse）和无追索权（without recourse）两种模式下债权转让及违约风险分担的合法性。研究采用规范法律方法，结合法律条文、融资企业的相关规定以及学术文献，通过语法和系统化的解读来进行分析。研究结果表明：债权购买协议的合法性、债权通过“cessie”（法律转让方式）的转移，以及对债务人的法律约束力，均需满足特定的法律要件并产生相应的法律后果。卖方对债权存在性的责任与债务人履行义务的能力是相互独立的。在有追索权模式下，风险分担取决于合同条款的具体内容、承担责任的限度以及支付行为对债权的影响；而在无追索权模式下，融资企业需承担债权无法收回的风险，同时债务人的义务及卖方对债权存在性的责任依然有效。第三方担保、债权回购（buyback）及代位求偿（subrogation）等行为均会根据相关合同条款产生相应的法律后果。“平衡原则”被用于判...。

papers.title: Financial Health Profile and Formal Compliance of Corporate Taxpayers at Jakarta Tanah Abang Tiga Tax Office
papers.abstract: Under the self-assessment system, corporate taxpayer compliance is commonly judged by tax return submission, although financial condition may affect the ability to meet tax obligations. Evidence on their relationship is mixed and relies largely on perception surveys. This study aims to describe the financial condition, tax return reporting status, and direction of tax payments of corporate taxpayers, and to classify them into levels with recommended treatments. It uses a descriptive quantitative approach with secondary data from the financial statements attached to the tax returns for tax years 2022 and 2023 of 15 active corporate taxpayers, randomly selected at the Jakarta Tanah Abang Tiga Primary Tax Service Office. Financial condition was assessed using Net Profit Margin, Cash Ratio, and Debt to Equity Ratio. The results show that healthy taxpayers declined on all three ratios, from nine to eight for Net Profit Margin, from nine to seven for Cash Ratio, and from thirteen to twelve for Debt to Equity Ratio. Only four taxpayers (26.7 percent) were healthy on all ratios in 2023. All taxpayers reported their tax returns, whereas tax payments grew for seven taxpayers and declined for eight. The classification produced four taxpayer levels. Because reporting did not vary, these findings cannot be used to infer a relationship between financial condition and compliance. Financial ratios may serve as supplementary input for risk-based supervision, within the limits of a small sample and general ratio benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在自我评估制度下，企业纳税人的合规情况通常通过提交纳税申报表来评判，尽管其财务状况可能会影响其履行纳税义务的能力。关于二者之间关系的证据并不充分，主要依赖于调查问卷的反馈。本研究旨在描述企业纳税人的财务状况、纳税申报表提交情况以及税款缴纳情况，并将其划分为不同的等级，同时提出相应的管理建议。研究采用描述性定量分析方法，利用2022年和2023年度15家活跃企业纳税人的纳税申报表中所附的财务报表作为二手数据。这些企业是在雅加达Tanah Abang Tiga初级税务服务办公室随机选取的。财务状况的评估指标包括净利润率、现金比率和资产负债率。结果显示，这些纳税人的各项财务指标均有所下降：净利润率从9%降至8%，现金比率从9%降至7%，资产负债率从13%降至12%。2023年仅有4家纳税人在所有指标上都符合健康标准（占比26.7%）。所有纳税人均提交了纳税申报表，其中7家纳税人的税款缴纳金额有所增加，8家纳税人的税款缴纳金额有所减少。根据评估结果，这些纳税人被划分为四个不同的等级。由于纳税申报表的提交情况在各组之间没有显著差异，因此无法据此推断财务状况与纳税合规性之间的直接关系。尽管样...。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Fast-Track Mergers: Fast in Name, Slow in Practice? An Assessment of India's Merger Framework
papers.venue: International Journal of Law Management & Humanities
papers.abstract: Fast-track mergers were introduced in India with the objective of making the merger process simpler, quicker, and less burdensome for eligible companies. The framework was intended to provide a practical alternative to the conventional merger route, which often involves lengthy proceedings before the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), along with multiple regulatory approvals and procedural requirements. However, despite being designed as an expedited mechanism, the actual implementation of fast-track mergers raises questions about whether the process is truly capable of delivering timely and efficient outcomes. This paper examines the effectiveness of India’s fast-track merger framework and evaluates whether the procedure has achieved its intended objective of reducing the time and regulatory burden associated with corporate restructuring. The paper analyses the legal framework governing fast-track mergers under the Companies Act, 2013, and the relevant rules and regulatory developments. It further examines the procedural requirements involved, including approval by shareholders and creditors, declarations of solvency, scrutiny by the Regional Director and other authorities, and the circumstances in which a merger may be required to follow the conventional NCLT route. The paper argues that while the fast-track mechanism represents an important step towards simplifying corporate restructuring, procedural complexities, regulatory overlaps, and uncertainty in implementation can undermine its effectiveness. The study also considers recent reforms aimed at expanding and streamlining the fast-track merger mechanism and assesses whether these changes are sufficient to address the practical difficulties faced by companies. By examining the gap between the intended speed of the framework and its practical operation, the research seeks to determine whether fast-track mergers are genuinely “fast” or merely faster in theory. Finally, the paper proposes reforms aimed at reducing procedural delays, improving regulatory coordination, and creating a more predictable and efficient merger process in India.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】印度引入了快速并购机制，旨在简化并购流程、提高效率，并减轻符合条件的公司的负担。该机制旨在为传统的并购路径提供一种更为便捷的替代方案；传统路径通常需要经过国家公司法法庭（NCLT）的漫长程序，以及多项监管审批和程序性要求。然而，尽管这一机制被设计为加速流程的手段，但其实际执行效果仍存在疑问——它是否真的能够实现及时、高效的结果？本文探讨了印度快速并购机制的有效性，并评估该程序是否实现了减少企业重组所需时间和监管负担的目标。研究分析了《2013年公司法》中关于快速并购的法律框架及相关法规变化，同时探讨了其中涉及的程序性要求，包括股东和债权人的批准、偿付能力声明、地区监管机构的审查，以及哪些情况下并购必须遵循传统的NCLT流程。文章指出，虽然快速并购机制是简化企业重组的重要步骤，但程序复杂性、监管重叠以及实施过程中的不确定性可能会削弱其效果。研究还分析了近期为扩大和简化该机制而进行的改革，并评估这些变革是否足以解决企业面临的实际问题。通过对比该机制的预期速度与其实际运作情况，研究试图判断快速并购机制是否真正具备“快速”特性，还是仅仅在理论上更为高效。最后，本文提出了减少程序延误、改善...。

papers.title: Effect of Digital Financial Inclusion on Access to Agricultural Finance Among Smallholder Farmers in Selected States in North Central Nigeria
papers.venue: International Journal of Economics and Financial Management
papers.abstract:
This study examined the effect of digital financial inclusion on access to agricultural finance 
among smallholder farmers in Benue, Kogi and Nasarawa States and the Federal Capital Territory, 
Nigeria. Kwara, Niger and Plateau States were excluded to maintain a manageable geographical 
scope. A cross-sectional survey design was adopted, and 440 questionnaires were administered, of 
which 387 valid responses were analysed. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire 
and analysed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling in SmartPLS 4. The 
findings showed that FinTech-based credit access had a strong positive and significant effect on 
access to agricultural finance (β = 0.924, p < 0.001). Agent-banking accessibility (β = 0.293, p < 
0.001) and digital payment usage (β = 0.098, p < 0.001) also had positive and significant effects. 
Digital financial literacy had a negative but significant effect (β = −0.279, p < 0.001), while 
mobile banking usage had a negative and insignificant effect (β = −0.067, p = 0.069). The study 
concluded that digital financial inclusion improves agricultural-finance access when it provides 
affordable, timely and suitable credit rather than connectivity and routine transactions alone. It 
recommended expanding farmer-oriented FinTech credit, strengthening rural agent-banking 
networks, using digital payment histories for credit assessment and aligning digital loan 
conditions with agricultural production cycles.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】本研究探讨了数字金融包容性对尼日利亚贝努埃州、科吉州、纳萨拉瓦州以及联邦首都特区的小农获取农业金融服务的影响。为保持研究的地理范围在可管理的范围内，尼日尔州的夸拉州和普拉托州未被纳入研究范围。研究采用了横断面调查设计，共发放了440份问卷，其中387份有效问卷被纳入分析。数据通过结构化问卷收集，并使用SmartPLS 4软件中的偏最小二乘结构方程模型（Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling）进行分析。研究结果表明，基于金融科技（FinTech）的信贷服务对小农获取农业金融服务的能力具有显著的积极影响（β = 0.924，p < 0.001）；代理银行服务（agent-banking）的可及性（β = 0.293，p < 0.001）以及数字支付方式的使用（β = 0.098，p < 0.001）也具有积极的影响。然而，数字金融素养（digital financial literacy）对小农获取农业金融服务的能力具有负向但显著的影响（β = −0.279，p < 0.001），而移动银行服务的使用（mobile ba...。研究方法：横截面分析、调查数据。

papers.title: Peer Effects in Digital Finance Usage and Rural Household Consumption: A Double Machine Learning Approach
papers.abstract: Using data from the China Household Finance Survey (CHFS), this study develops a simplified intertemporal household consumption‐saving model and uses double machine learning to examine peer effects in digital finance usage and their influence on rural household consumption. The results show significant peer effects in rural households' digital finance usage. The estimates further show that peer households' digital finance usage is positively related to consumption among focal households. The positive relationship is more pronounced among households with greater wealth, higher education levels and lower degrees of ageing. Mechanism analyses suggest that peer households' digital finance usage is linked to weaker liquidity constraints and lower precautionary saving motives among focal households. Further analysis indicates that peer households' digital finance usage relates to both survival‐oriented consumption and development‐oriented consumption, as well as greater breadth of consumption‐category participation. Accordingly, this study argues that strengthening the social learning effect of digital finance usage is crucial for enhancing rural households' consumption capacity and fostering sustainable rural economic development.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】本研究利用中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）的数据，构建了一个简化的家庭消费-储蓄跨期模型，并采用双重机器学习方法来分析数字金融使用中的同伴效应及其对农村家庭消费的影响。研究结果表明，农村家庭在数字金融使用方面存在显著的同伴效应。进一步分析发现，同伴家庭的数字金融使用与核心家庭的消费行为呈正相关关系，这种正向关系在财富较多、受教育程度较高且老龄化程度较低的家庭中更为明显。机制分析表明，同伴家庭的数字金融使用有助于降低核心家庭的流动性约束，并减弱其预防性储蓄动机。此外，研究还发现，同伴家庭的数字金融使用与以生存为导向的消费、以发展为导向的消费以及更广泛的消费类别参与度均有关联。因此，本研究认为，强化数字金融使用的社会学习效应对于提升农村家庭的消费能力和促进农村经济的可持续发展具有重要意义。。研究方法：机器学习、调查数据。

papers.title: Strategy Improvement Performance Management Regional Finance in the Kampar Regency Regional Government
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: Regional financial management is an important part in supporting the implementation of government and achieving goals. regional development. Although the Kampar Regency Government was able to maintain an Unqualified Opinion (WTP), this achievement does not fully reflect the optimality of the entire regional financial management process. This study aims to identify internal and external conditions and formulate strategies to improve the performance of regional financial management in Kampar Regency. The study uses qualitative descriptive approach with SWOT analysis. Ten informants were purposively selected based on their involvement and knowledge of regional financial management. Data were obtained through interviews, observation, and documentation, supported by secondary data on revenue, expenditure, Regional Original Income (PAD), and the Audit Board of Indonesia's Audit Board (BPK) opinion for the 2021–2025 period. The results showed that internal factors received an IFAS score of 2.85, while external factors received an EFAS score of 3.30. This indicates that internal strengths are relatively dominant, and the Kampar Regency Government own ability Which Enough Good in utilise opportunity external. This position places regional financial management in Quadrant I, so the prioritized strategy is an aggressive or growth-oriented strategy. Recommended strategies include optimizing the digitalization of financial management through SIPD and SPBE, improving the quality of planning and optimizing PAD (Regional Revenue), strengthening spending control, enhancing the competence of civil servants, and enhancing transparency and oversight. The research results indicate that improving financial management performance is not sufficient simply to maintain quality. financial accountability, but needs to be directed at increasing the effectiveness, efficiency, transparency and quality of budget utilization.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】区域财务管理是支持政府政策实施和实现区域发展目标的重要组成部分。尽管甘帕尔县政府能够保持“无保留意见”（WTP）的审计评级，但这一成绩并不能完全反映其区域财务管理过程的优化程度。本研究旨在识别影响区域财务管理绩效的内部和外部因素，并制定相应的改进策略。研究采用了定性描述方法及SWOT分析工具。根据受访者对区域财务管理的参与度和了解程度，有针对性地选取了10位受访者作为研究对象。数据主要通过访谈、观察及文献资料收集获得，同时参考了2021–2025年度的财政收入、支出数据、区域原始收入（PAD）以及印度尼西亚审计委员会（BPK）的审计报告。研究结果显示：内部因素的IFAS评分为2.85，外部因素的EFAS评分为3.30，表明内部优势相对突出，甘帕尔县政府在利用外部机会方面具备较强的能力。因此，该地区的财务管理属于第一象限（增长导向型区域），相应的优先策略应为积极进取或增长导向型的发展策略。建议采取的措施包括：通过SIPD和SPBE项目推进财务管理的数字化进程；提升规划质量并优化区域收入（PAD）管理；加强支出控制；提升公务员的专业能力；以及增强财务管理的透明度和监督机制。研究结果表...。

papers.title: Failing Factories, Fearful Finance: Reimagining Pakistani Banking Through the German Hausbank Lens
papers.venue: Student Journal of Business and Economics
papers.abstract: This paper compares Pakistan’s commercial banking sector and Germany's universal Hausbank model in order to determine why Pakistani small and medium enterprises suffer from credit starvation while large corporations secure adequate financing. Legal constraints, court recovery bottlenecks (judicial liquidation delays), and high fiscal borrowing force Pakistani commercial banks to rely on heavy physical collateral and low-risk sovereign securities such as Treasury bills rather than industrial lendings. The feasibility of implementing the Hausbank model in Pakistan is discussed by gathering data collected from qualitative interviews involving high-ranking banking officers and from secondary sources. It highlights why senior bankers reject the Hausbank model, referring to opaque family-owned businesses that dominate Pakistan's corporate governance. Similarly, it explores how government debt causes the banks to shift their liquidity, removing financial incentives to extend credit to the private sector. Regardless, the paper discusses a third approach to tackle the risky, complex economic climate of Pakistan.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】本文比较了巴基斯坦的商业银行体系与德国的“全能银行”（Hausbank）模式，旨在探讨为何巴基斯坦的中小企业难以获得信贷支持，而大型企业却能轻松获得充足的资金。法律限制、法院清算程序的瓶颈（如司法清算拖延）以及高额的财政债务迫使巴基斯坦商业银行依赖实物抵押品和低风险的国家债券（如国库券），而非向工业企业提供贷款。通过收集来自高级银行官员的定性访谈资料及二手文献，本文探讨了在巴基斯坦实施“全能银行”模式的可行性。文章指出，高级银行家之所以反对这一模式，是因为巴基斯坦的企业治理结构主要由不透明的家族企业主导。同时，文章还分析了政府债务如何导致银行调整其流动性配置，从而削弱了向私营部门提供信贷的积极性。尽管如此，本文仍提出了一种应对巴基斯坦复杂风险经济环境的第三种解决方案。。

papers.title: The Impact of BNPL on Adolescents' Financial Behavior and Perceptions in a Digital Credit Environment
papers.venue: Advances in Economics, Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: Amid the rapid expansion of digital finance, "Buy Now, Pay Later" (BNPL), a new type of digital credit tool, has become increasingly embedded in mobile payment ecosystems and gained growing popularity among young consumers. At the same time, adolescents' financial literacy is still underdeveloped and their ability to identify risks is limited, making them more prone to irrational consumption behavior when using digital credit tools. Thus, it is necessary to explore the potential impact of BNPL on adolescents' financial behavior and cognitive structures. This paper investigates the mechanisms through which BNPL affects adolescents' consumption patterns and financial awareness, as well as the resulting outcomes. Moreover, it also examines how BNPL shapes consumption decisions, saving practices, and perceptions of credit, while further exploring its role in the accumulation of financial risks. Through the lenses of bounded rationality, the pain-of-payment effect, intertemporal choice, and mental accounting, this paper identifies the pathways through which BNPL influences consumption decisions and risk perceptions based on existing research on digital credit tools and youth consumption behavior. The results indicate that by diminishing the immediate pain of payment, delaying the sense of payment responsibility, and blurring the boundaries between credit and assets, BNPL induces adolescents to shift their consumption structure toward enjoyment-oriented and non-essential goods at the behavioral level. At the cognitive level, it reinforces optimistic bias and misjudgments regarding credit, thereby weakening their awareness of the need to save and their ability to perceive risk.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】在数字金融迅速发展的背景下，一种新型的数字信贷工具——“先买后付”（Buy Now, Pay Later，简称BNPL）逐渐融入移动支付生态系统，并在年轻消费者中广受欢迎。然而，青少年的金融素养尚未充分发展，他们的风险识别能力有限，这使得他们在使用数字信贷工具时更容易出现非理性消费行为。因此，有必要探讨BNPL对青少年金融行为和认知结构的潜在影响。本文研究了BNPL如何影响青少年的消费模式和金融意识，以及由此产生的后果。同时，还分析了BNPL如何塑造他们的消费决策、储蓄习惯以及对信贷的认知，并进一步探讨了其在积累金融风险中的作用。基于有限理性、支付痛苦效应、跨期选择和心理账户等理论框架，本文结合现有关于数字信贷工具和青少年消费行为的研究，揭示了BNPL影响消费决策和风险认知的机制。研究结果表明，通过减轻即时的支付痛苦、延迟支付责任感以及模糊信贷与资产之间的界限，BNPL在行为层面上促使青少年将消费重心转向以享受为导向的非必需品；在认知层面上，它强化了青少年的乐观偏见和对信贷的错误认知，从而削弱了他们的储蓄意识及风险识别能力。。
